ucs.title: [LLM] Peach Sandstorm (APT33) Entra ID password-spray followed by successful sign-in from the spraying IP
ucs.description: Detects APT33/Peach Sandstorm's signature low-and-slow password-spray campaigns (mass-targeted in 2023 against aerospace, satellite, defense and energy tenants) by correlating a single source IP failing auth against many distinct Entra ID accounts with a subsequent SUCCESS from that same IP — the moment a sprayed credential lands.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstFail max(_time) as lastFail from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action=failure by Authentication.src, Authentication.user, _time span=1h
| `drop_dm_object_name("Authentication")`
| stats dc(user) as failed_users, sum(count) as fail_count, values(user) as targeted_users, min(firstFail) as spray_start, max(lastFail) as spray_end by src
| where failed_users >= 15            `` 15 = P99 of distinct-user auth failures per src IP per hour from 30-day baseline ``
| join type=inner src [
    | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as success_time from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action=success by Authentication.src, Authentication.user
    | `drop_dm_object_name("Authentication")`
    | rename user as compromised_user ]
| where success_time >= spray_start AND success_time <= (spray_end + 7200)   `` success within 2h of the spray window ``
| table spray_start, success_time, src, compromised_user, failed_users, fail_count, targeted_users
| sort - success_time
ucs.kql:
let SprayWindow = 1h;
let FailThreshold = 15;   // P99 of distinct sprayed users per IP/hr from 30d baseline
let Sprays = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ErrorCode in (50126, 50053, 50055, 50056)   // bad creds / locked / expired / must-change
    | summarize FailedUsers = dcount(AccountUpn), FailCount = count(),
                TargetedUsers = make_set(AccountUpn, 100)
                by IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, SprayWindow)
    | where FailedUsers >= FailThreshold;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ErrorCode == 0                                  // successful interactive/non-interactive sign-in
| join kind=inner Sprays on IPAddress
| where Timestamp between (Timestamp1 .. Timestamp1 + 2h)
| project SuccessTime = Timestamp, IPAddress, CompromisedUser = AccountUpn,
          FailedUsers, FailCount, Country, City, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, TargetedUsers
| order by SuccessTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SprayWindow = 1h;
let FailThreshold = 15;   // P99 of distinct sprayed users per IP/hr from 30d baseline
let Sprays = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ResultType in ("50126","50053","50055","50056")
    | summarize FailedUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName), FailCount = count(),
                TargetedUsers = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 100)
                by IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, SprayWindow)
    | where FailedUsers >= FailThreshold;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == "0"
| join kind=inner Sprays on IPAddress
| where TimeGenerated between (TimeGenerated1 .. TimeGenerated1 + 2h)
| project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, IPAddress, CompromisedUser = UserPrincipalName,
          FailedUsers, FailCount, Location, AppDisplayName, UserAgent, TargetedUsers
| order by SuccessTime desc
ucs.rationale: Password spraying against cloud identity at scale is the defining 2023 Peach Sandstorm (APT33 / Refined Kitten / Elfin / Holmium) TTP per Microsoft's Sept-2023 reporting — they sprayed thousands of orgs from rotating IPs and pivoted on the rare success. The success-from-spraying-IP correlation is what separates this from a generic spray template: it fires only when a sprayed credential actually au

ucs.title: [LLM] Holmium (APT33) HTA/Office-to-PowerShell download cradle (POWERTON / POSHC2 stager)
ucs.description: Hunts APT33's spearphishing execution chain where a job-themed .hta or Office lure spawns PowerShell that pulls a second-stage backdoor (POWERTON, POSHC2, NanoCore/NetWire droppers). Pairs the actor-characteristic mshta/wscript/Office parent with an obfuscated download-cradle child command line.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","outlook.exe")) AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*-enc*" OR Processes.process="*EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadFile*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*Net.WebClient*" OR Processes.process="*-nop*" OR Processes.process="*hidden*") by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.parent_process, Processes.process_name, Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| where NOT user="*$"
| `ctime(firstTime)` | `ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime, lastTime, dest, user, parent_process_name, parent_process, process
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","outlook.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","FromBase64String","Net.WebClient","-nop","hidden")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","outlook.exe")
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","DownloadString","DownloadFile","IEX","Invoke-Expression","FromBase64String","Net.WebClient","-nop","hidden")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT33/Holmium HTA or Office spawning PowerShell download cradle
id: 7d2f4c91-3b6a-4e2e-9f0a-2c1d8e6b4a55
status: experimental
description: Detects an mshta/wscript/cscript or Office process spawning PowerShell with an obfuscated download-cradle command line, matching APT33 (Holmium/Elfin) spearphishing-to-POWERTON/POSHC2 staging.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-enc'
      - 'EncodedCommand'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - '-nop'
      - 'hidden'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate admin automation launched from signed Office macros (rare; verify the download URL)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1105
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe) (@CommandLine:*EncodedCommand* OR @CommandLine:*-enc* OR @CommandLine:*DownloadString* OR @CommandLine:*DownloadFile* OR @CommandLine:*IEX* OR @CommandLine:*FromBase64String* OR @CommandLine:*Net.WebClient* OR @CommandLine:*-nop*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(mshta|wscript|cscript|winword|excel|outlook)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh)\.exe/i
| regex("(?i)(-enc|encodedcommand|downloadstring|downloadfile|iex|invoke-expression|frombase64string|net\.webclient|-nop|-w\s+hidden)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: APT33 (Holmium/Elfin) is documented using .hta lures and HTA/Office-launched PowerShell to stage POWERTON and POSHC2 backdoors and AutoIt/NanoCore/NetWire droppers. The mshta/Office-parent + PowerShell-download-cradle child is the actor's repeated install-stage fingerprint; the parent/child pairing plus obfuscated cradle keywords cuts the generic-PowerShell noise that a bare powershell.exe filter
